title: Snap-to-vertex / snap-to-edge picking
description: Shows the WebGLRenderer's snap-pick pipeline. As the cursor moves over a small table SceneModel, every `mousemove` is routed through `renderer.pick(view, {canvasPos, snapToVertex, snapToEdge, snapRadius})`. The renderer rasterises the surrounding pickable vertices and edges into a tiny RGBA32F framebuffer centred on the cursor, scans for the nearest non-empty texel, and reports the world-space snap target. A small marker re-tints itself red / amber / teal depending on whether the result is a vertex snap, an edge snap, or a plain surface pick.
